correctness.rationale: The contracted-digraph derivation is complete: there are \(n(n-2)\) arcs, every acyclic subgraph fits a topological order, and the deleted permutation-cycle cover contributes at least and exactly one forward missing arc per cycle. This proves \(af(\operatorname{Cr}_n,M_\pi)=n(n-3)/2+c(\pi)\). The recurrence and extremal counts are independently derived from cycle decompositions. The embedded verifier confirms the formula by two separate exact finite methods on all tested matchings.
risks: The finite verifier is not an infinite proof; universality rests on the analytic order argument.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification on the canonical crown family. It turns a generally difficult matching-specific anti-forcing problem into an exact cycle statistic, determines every coefficient of the distribution, proves a gapless spectrum, and counts both extremal layers. The dense feedback-digraph lemma is structurally reusable rather than a one-off numerical computation.
risks: The result is family-specific and does not by itself solve anti-forcing on general matching-deleted bipartite graphs.
